_meta._note: Chapter 64, Final test (ch64-test, new). Twelve multiple-choice questions at 80 % (9/12 fails, 10/12 passes) in the proposal's 2 + 3 + 2 + 2 + 3 allocation: a nominal core and a verb-first sentence (q01–02), the three predicate kinds (q03–05), the outer subject and an attached doer (q06–07), a verbal-clause span and a nominal-clause span (q08–09), and three reading questions — Al-Balad across both parts, Al-Ghashiyah's two sets of faces and Al-Ghashiyah's ending (q10–12). Correct options are placed 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 and every question supplies its own sentence or excerpt. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 8 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-64-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.
